verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents Datasets as reusable test-case sets and offline experiments against them (run_experiment, UI/SDK experiments, run comparison, CI/CD gating). A hands-on user reports extracting production generations into datasets to test edge cases, which corroborates curation from production traces. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the trace-to-dataset curation workflow (e.g. adding traces or observations to a dataset), and detail on filtering or selecting production traces for curation.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: Build a reusable set of test cases | Datasets
Wrap the function you want to test in an experiment task, run it on a fixed dataset, and use Langfuse to compare outputs and review failures.
They extract production generations into datasets to test edge cases
Use production data to understand behavior, collaborate on fixes
